text:
mira: Observed duplicated tail fragments when resuming SSE after very short disconnects (~100-300ms). Client reconnects with Last-Event-ID and the first event after resume repeats the last fragment.

mira: Quick paste from client log:

# before glitch
event: message
id: 2042
data: {\"seq\":2042,\"chunk\":\"partA\"}

# after reconnect (Last-Event-ID: 2042)
event: message
id: 2042
data: {\"seq\":2042,\"chunk\":\"partA\"}
event: message
id: 2043
data: {\"seq\":2043,\"chunk\":\"partB\"}

mira: Client concatenates -> \"partApartA partB\". Happens for tokens split mid-fragment.

sam: Is server intentionally replaying seq 2042? If yes, client should dedupe by id.

alex: Server resume currently replays last acked fragment to avoid lost tokens. Two options: change server to avoid replay when Last-Event-ID provided, or add client-side dedupe. Short-term: SDK can drop first event when its id == lastSeenId.

sam: Proposed SDK change: add opt-in flag `resumeDedup=true`. Implementation: keep lastSeenId, on reconnect set skipNextIfSameId, drop first event if id matches. Add unit test simulating 200ms outage.

mira: Also saw this with auth refresh mid-resume — sometimes routed to different backend that also replays tail fragments, making dedupe important.

alex: Long-term: add atomic resume header (e.g., Redwood-Resume-Seq) so server won't replay. For now, SDK change plus integration test.

mira: Can someone open an issue with repro steps + logs? I can attach a tiny mocha harness.

devex-bot: Created issue #5477: \"sse: duplicated fragment on resume; implement client dedupe\" - https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/issues/5477 :thumbsup:

sam: I'll own adding the opt-in flag to SDKs. alex -> can you coordinate protocol header change with infra?

alex: Yep, will sync with infra. Will draft SDK PR for node + browser today.

mira: Thanks — adding this to next sprint.
